description: This file defines utility functions for process management, including killing processes by name and retrieving child process IDs, using the Linux /proc interface.

methods.name: killProcess
methods.description: Kills all processes with the specified process name by iterating over /proc entries and sending SIGTERM.

methods.name: getChildProcessIDs
methods.description: Retrieves the list of child process IDs for a given parent process ID by reading /proc entries.
